plan: With a private value of $18, my goal is to win the auction while minimizing the price I pay. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a strategic bid close to, but slightly below my true value. Bidding exactly $18 risks paying too close to my value. I'll bid $16.50 - this gives me a buffer to potentially win while ensuring positive profit if I win. This approach balances winning probability with profit margin.

I'll bid slightly below my true value to ensure I win if others bid lower, but not overpay. A bid around $14.5 seems strategic - high enough to likely win, but leaving some profit margin.
